title: Final velocity value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or correctly calculate the final constant velocity as 10 m/s.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the condition for constant velocity, equating gravitational force to the magnetic damping force (mg = B²L²v/R).

title: Joule heat value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or correctly calculate the total Joule heat generated as 12 J.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply energy conservation, stating that the loss in gravitational potential energy mg(h+L) equals the gain in kinetic energy plus the heat dissipated.

title: Fall time value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or correctly calculate the total fall time as 1.1 s.

title: Momentum/impulse method
description: Important Criteria: The response must use the impulse-momentum theorem or equivalent (mg t - BIL Δt = mv) and relate the current-time integral to the change in magnetic flux.

title: Correct displacement for energy
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalise if the gravitational potential energy change is incorrectly calculated using only height h, instead of the correct total distance (h+L) the center of mass falls.

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalise if the direction of the magnetic force (retarding) is incorrectly stated or if the signs in the force balance or impulse equation are wrong.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Award credit if the response demonstrates unit analysis for key equations (e.g., force, energy, impulse).
